from AlgorithmImports import *


class TwoSlotStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.prev_spy_sma is not None
        rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
        previous_prices_ready = (
            self.prev_spy_close is not None and
            self.prev_aapl_close is not None
        )

        spy_crosses_above = (
            spy_sma_ready and
            previous_prices_ready and
            self.prev_spy_close <= self.prev_spy_sma and
            spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        spy_crosses_below = (
            spy_sma_ready and
            previous_prices_ready and
            self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_spy_sma and
            spy_close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        )

        if self.prev_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        aapl_sell_reason = rsi_ready and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and spy_sma_ready and previous_prices_ready:
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and rsi_ready and previous_prices_ready:
            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and spy_sma_ready and previous_prices_ready:
            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if not self.IsWarmingUp and rsi_ready and previous_prices_ready:
            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
                available_cash = self.Portfolio.Cash
                if available_cash >= 20000:
                    quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_close

class TwoStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        available = {
            symbol: data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol)
            for symbol in symbols
        }

        if available[self.spy] and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            spy_close = data[self.spy].Close
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            spy_crosses_above = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma and
                spy_close > current_spy_sma
            )

            spy_crosses_below = (
                self.previous_spy_close is not None and
                self.previous_spy_sma is not None and
                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma and
                spy_close < current_spy_sma
            )
        else:
            spy_close = None
            current_spy_sma = None
            spy_crosses_above = False
            spy_crosses_below = False

        if available[self.aapl]:
            aapl_close = data[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        else:
            aapl_close = None

        if not all(available.values()):
            self._update_market_state(
                spy_close,
                current_spy_sma,
                aapl_close
            )
            return

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self._update_market_state(
                spy_close,
                current_spy_sma,
                aapl_close
            )
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._update_market_state(
                spy_close,
                current_spy_sma,
                aapl_close
            )
            return

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
            )

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if (
            self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and
            self.aapl_red_streak >= 3 and
            self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
        ):
            quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._update_market_state(
            spy_close,
            current_spy_sma,
            aapl_close
        )

    def _update_market_state(self, spy_close, spy_sma, aapl_close):
        if spy_close is not None and spy_sma is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma

        if aapl_close is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class TwoStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=100)
        self.spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
        self.RegisterIndicator(self.aapl, self.aapl_rsi, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0
        self.strategy_a_pending = False
        self.strategy_b_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        required = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.symbols["IBM"],
                    self.symbols["BAC"], self.symbols["AIG"]]

        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

        if len(self.spy_closes) < 100:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = None
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            return

        spy_sma = sum(self.spy_closes) / 100.0

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        if self.previous_spy_sma is None or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
            return

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        spy_crosses_above = spy_crosses_below

        spy_sell_signal = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_signal = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
        aapl_buy_signal = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and not self.strategy_a_pending:
            if spy_sell_signal:
                self.strategy_a_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    -self.strategy_a_lot,
                    tag="Strategy A liquidation"
                )
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and not self.strategy_b_pending:
            if aapl_sell_signal:
                self.strategy_b_pending = True
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.aapl,
                    -self.strategy_b_lot,
                    tag="Strategy B liquidation"
                )
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and not self.strategy_a_pending:
            if spy_crosses_above:
                portfolio_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                quantity = int(math.floor((portfolio_value * 0.40) / spy_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.strategy_a_pending = True
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.spy,
                        quantity,
                        tag="Strategy A buy"
                    )

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and not self.strategy_b_pending:
            if aapl_buy_signal and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.strategy_b_pending = True
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        quantity,
                        tag="Strategy B buy"
                    )

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.Status in [
            OrderStatus.Filled,
            OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled,
            OrderStatus.Canceled,
            OrderStatus.Invalid,
            OrderStatus.Rejected
        ]:
            order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
            if order is not None:
                if order.Tag.startswith("Strategy A"):
                    self.strategy_a_pending = False
                elif order.Tag.startswith("Strategy B"):
                    self.strategy_b_pending = False
